prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize carbohydrate intake and meal timing for marathon training with a 20km run scheduled at 10:00 AM

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers one full day with breakfast, pre-workout meal, post-workout meal, and dinner
Pre-workout meal is timed 2-3 hours before the 10:00 AM run and contains easily digestible carbohydrates
Post-workout meal within 30-60 minutes of run completion includes carbohydrates and protein for recovery
Total daily carbohydrate intake aligns with endurance athlete requirements (6-10g per kg body weight) and all restrictions are respected
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: muscle gain through strength training with caloric surplus

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly one day of meals with clear meal timing
Total daily protein is at least 170g (2g per kg bodyweight) distributed across meals
Total daily calories are in a 300-500 kcal surplus relative to maintenance needs for muscle gain
Plan is concise and practical (under 400 words)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing elevated protein distribution and caloric surplus for muscle gain

prompt_inputs.goal: Cut to 70 kg weight class while maintaining strength for wrestling competition in 3 days

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 3 meals totaling 1,800-2,000 calories to achieve safe daily deficit
All meals respect vegetarian, dairy-free, and nut-free restrictions
Includes hydration guidance appropriate for weight-class athlete with minimal water retention
Meals are compact and practical to consume during training/competition schedule
